steps.do: Greet the customer politely. Do not ask for identity verification and do not look up records. This protocol only explains direct deposit timing and handles transfer requests, so it accesses no customer records.
steps.quote: In these cases, kindly inform the customer about typical direct deposit timing (deposits usually post between 6 AM and 9 AM on the scheduled pay date, and some employers process payroll 1-2 business days before the official pay date while others process on the day itself).

steps.do: Reply to the customer's opening message politely and explain typical direct deposit timing. Deposits usually post between 6 AM and 9 AM on the scheduled pay date. Some employers process payroll 1-2 business days before the pay date, and others process on the pay date itself. Do not reveal internal protocol details such as the transfer count.
steps.quote: kindly inform the customer about typical direct deposit timing (deposits usually post between 6 AM and 9 AM on the scheduled pay date, and some employers process payroll 1-2 business days before the official pay date while others process on the day itself)

steps.do: Tell the customer to check back at the right time and to confirm their pay schedule with their employer.
steps.quote: Advise them to check back at the appropriate time and verify their pay schedule with their employer.

steps.do: Share the published troubleshooting tips. Direct deposits can take up to 3 days to arrive. The customer can contact the payer to confirm it paid, confirm their account and routing numbers with the payer, and ask the payer for the deposit trace information.
steps.quote: Direct deposits can take up to 3 days to arrive, depending on when your payer processes payroll and transmits the funds.

steps.do: Use this as a helpful comment. If the deposit was rejected, the customer should update their account details with the payer and ask the payer to resubmit the deposit.

steps.do: Use this as a helpful comment. With the Green Account (checking), funds can post up to 1 day early, but early availability depends on when the payer submits the deposit. An earlier pay cycle may have arrived early because the payer sent it early.

steps.quote: Early direct deposit availability depends on when your payer submits the deposit; funds can post up to 1 day early

Then add a helpful comment from explain_timing, advise_check_back, payer_troubleshooting, rejected_deposit_tip or green_account_early_deposit_tip.
